sections.summary: Frontend rework of the relaudit report panel: fixed two planted bugs (applyFilter >= severity compare; countTotal numeric sum), added dual filter controls, rule-grouped summary rows, per-row copy-fix-snippet buttons, and a single self-contained offline HTML — confined to public/* and src/render-panel.js.
